forward.basis: Weekly snapshots (every 5th session) from 2021; the 20-session sentiment board recomputed at each snapshot from final/adjusted closes with no lookahead; current sector constituents applied historically; forward returns measured relative to the stock's sector index; observations dropped when the forward window contains a single-session move over 15% (likely a corporate action).

methodology.provenance: This board is Nepse Decode's own published construction. The reference feature's definition is not publicly observable — its endpoints require an account and its published API schema carries no definition — so nothing here is presented as a copy of anyone else's formula. The construction below is complete: every figure on this page can be recomputed from it and our archive.
methodology.construction: For each stock and each window (5, 20 and 60 sessions), three sector-relative components are computed: (1) relative momentum — the stock's window return minus its sector index's window return, in percentage points; (2) up-day edge — the share of the window's sessions the stock closed up, minus the same share for its sector index, in percentage points; (3) flow-pressure edge — the stock's signed-volume pressure over the window (up-day volume minus down-day volume, over total volume) minus its sector's pooled pressure. Each component is percentile-ranked across the whole scored board (ties take the mean rank) and the sentiment score is the mean of the three percentiles, 0-100.
methodology.bands: Score >= 80 Strong Bullish · >= 60 Bullish · >= 40 Neutral · >= 20 Bearish · < 20 Strong Bearish. The labels describe where a stock's recent behaviour sits against its sector — they are descriptions of the recent past, not recommendations and not forecasts.
methodology.sector_basis: Sector indices are equal-weight composites of current constituents (the site's derived sector series), not official cap-weighted sub-indices. Our taxonomy has 11 sectors; Trading stocks sit inside Others.
methodology.forward: The forward-behaviour panel is measured history, not a promise: weekly snapshots since 2021, the same construction recomputed at each snapshot from final closes with no lookahead, then each stock's forward return measured against its own sector. Read it before reading anything into a high or low score.
methodology.coverage: A stock is scored on a window when it traded on the as-of session and has at least the window's sessions of earlier history with volume present. The rest are named per window as unscored rather than dropped silently.
